\newcommand{\R}{\mathbb{R}}
\newcommand{\norm}[1]{\left\lVert #1 \right\rVert}
\newcommand{\pair}[2][]{\langle #1 #2 \rangle}
\renewcommand{\vec}[1]{\mathbf{#1}}
\def\wrap#1#2{[#1|#2]}
\DeclareMathOperator{\tr}{tr}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\newenvironment{remarkbox}{\begin{quote}\textbf{Remark.}}{\end{quote}}

\section{Macros}
Let $x \in \R^n$ and $\norm{x} \le 1$. Also $\pair{x}{y}$ and $\tr(A)$.
We get \wrap{a}{b} in text.
\begin{remarkbox}
Macros expand inside environments.
\end{remarkbox}
\begin{theorem}[Main]\label{thm:main}
Every $\vec{v}$ has a norm.
